page_title: FIO 2-2 ROM | Fiorentina v AS Roma 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' 2 - 2 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Evan Ndicka and Diego Llorente (AS Roma) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 2:2.
90+5' The linesman makes the right call and AS Roma will have a corner.
90+2' Substitution. Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) replaces Rolando Mandragora.
90+1' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) replacing Maxime Lopez.
90+1' The referee signals a substitution. M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Andrea Belotti.

90+1' Pietro Terracciano makes a good save! Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) easily weaves through the defence and fires in from long range. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
88' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
85' Some neat passing and movement from AS Roma as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
84' Flag goes up against Dean Huijsen (AS Roma) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
81' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) commits a foul and Davide Massa immediately signals a free kick.
81' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) will take the corner.

80' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) steps up to the penalty spot. He attempts to confuse the goalkeeper by stopping in the middle of his run up and sends the ball to the bottom left corner, but Mile Svilar keeps his cool to thwart him.
80' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
80' Daniele De Rossi decides to make a substitution. Angelino will be replaced by Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma).
79' Substitution. Leandro Paredes walks off the pitch and Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) comes on as a substitute.
79' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul. That's a penalty to Fiorentina! They have a good chance to score now.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) will replace Riccardo Sottil.
77' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Mile Svilar comes off his line to gather the ball.
76' The game is interrupted. Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
73' Here is a change. Stephan El Shaarawy is going off and Daniele De Rossi gives the last tactical orders to Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma).
73' The substitution has been made. Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) has replaced Paulo Dybala.
69' 2 - 1 GOAL! Andrea Belotti meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 2:1.
68' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
65' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
63' The foul by Dean Huijsen (AS Roma) was seen by Davide Massa who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
58' 1 - 1 Goal! Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Angelino and easily beat the keeper with a header into the top left corner from close range. 1:1.
57' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
57' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
55' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina). Davide Massa saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
53' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.

50' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Pietro Terracciano makes a great save.

50' Dean Huijsen (AS Roma) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for AS Roma.
48' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from AS Roma.
46' A dangerous looking corner kick from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is cleared to safety by the defence.
46' Substitution. Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nicolas Gonzalez walks off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Davide Massa blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Booking. Dean Huijsen (AS Roma) receives a caution from the referee.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
42' The linesman raises his flag. Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) is adjudged offside.
41' Mile Svilar leaps to intercept the corner kick from Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina).

40' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort. The ball is out of play. Fiorentina win a corner kick.
39' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball low inside the left post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
37' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) has tested the patience of referee Davide Massa and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

35' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) in a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes with a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better. His effort ends wide of the right post.
34' Ooh that was close! Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
33' Daniele De Rossi has decided to substitute Gianluca Mancini and he is replaced by Dean Huijsen (AS Roma).
32' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Davide Massa blows for a foul.
32' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
31' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fiorentina.
31' Angelino (AS Roma) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Davide Massa who sees an offensive foul.
29' Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) takes a short corner kick.
29' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It will be a corner kick for Fiorentina.
27' The game is interrupted. Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
25' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) is penalised for holding. Davide Massa signals a set piece.
24' There's an opportunity for Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

24' Mile Svilar was forced into action to thwart Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper. Corner kick. Fiorentina will have an opportunity.
23' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is lurking on the edge of the box and receives a pass from Nicolas Gonzalez. He shows nice control before hitting a soft shot just wide of the left post.

22' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Davide Massa stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Fiorentina win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
21' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
20' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Houssem Aouar (AS Roma), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. AS Roma have a corner.
19' 1 - 0 Goal! Nicolas Gonzalez gets up really well from the corner and heads the ball into the six-yard box where Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) glances a header into the net. 1:0.
18' Fiorentina will take a corner kick.

18' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) wastes no time in going for goal after collecting a rebound, but his long-range effort is comfortably blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
17' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
16' What a sweet pass and great technique by Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) as he finds his teammate with a precise lofted through ball.
15' AS Roma are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
13' Davide Massa blows his whistle and it's Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
12' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina).
11' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
10' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Michael Kayode (Fiorentina).
8' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) swings it in and Giacomo Bonaventura gets on the end of it, but Mile Svilar shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
7' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
7' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
6' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.

5' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom right corner, but Pietro Terracciano made an astonishing save!
4' Fiorentina keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.

3' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
2' Angelino (AS Roma) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Davide Massa got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
